description: Building knowledge and techniques for autonomous agents

rustic.description: Natural, weathered look using wood and stone
tips: Mix cobblestone with mossy cobblestone for aged look

medieval.description: Castle-like structures with stone and dark wood
tips: Add arrow slits with iron bars
Use dark oak for interior details

modern.description: Clean lines with concrete and glass
tips: Keep roofs flat or slightly angled
Add mystical gardens with chorus plants

underground.description: Dwarf-style carved into mountains or underground
tips: Create grand halls with high ceilings
Add mining cart tracks for atmosphere
Use hay bales for rustic charm
Use dark wood for spooky feel

foundations.flat: Clear area and place floor blocks directly
foundations.raised: Build platform 1-3 blocks above ground with stone steps leading up
foundations.sunken: Dig into ground and build down, add drainage moat
foundations.stilts: Use pillars to elevate structure above terrain or water
foundations.mixed: Combine terrain levels - part raised, part sunken for visual interest

walls.pillared: Columns at corners with different material fill
walls.layered: Outer decorative layer + inner structural layer for depth
walls.textured: Mix similar materials (stone_bricks + cracked + mossy) for age

roofs.flat: Simple flat surface (good for modern), add railings + rooftop garden
roofs.peaked: Use stairs in A-frame pattern, extend eaves 1-2 blocks
roofs.hipped: Stairs on all four sides meeting at top
roofs.dome: Curved using stairs in circular pattern
roofs.curved: Use stairs to create wave or curve shapes
roofs.multilevel: Different roof heights for wings/sections add complexity
roofs.dormer: Add small windowed protrusions from sloped roofs

details.depth: Push or pull sections to add visual interest - recess windows, extend corners
details.contrast: Use 2-3 materials that complement each other
details.lighting: Add torches, lanterns, or glowstone strategically

decorationPhases.description: Complete builds in phases for maximum detail

phase2_exterior.name: Exterior Details
tasks: Create chimney with campfire for smoke
Add overhanging eaves and gutters (upside-down stairs)

phase3_interior.name: Interior Finishing
tasks: Floor variations (rugs from carpet, patterns with slabs)
Lighting (lanterns on chains, wall torches, hidden glowstone)

phase4_landscaping.name: Exterior Landscaping
tasks: Paths connecting entrances (cobble, gravel, or stone_brick variants)
Gardens with flower_pots and planted flowers
Trees and bushes (leaf blocks on fence posts)
Seating areas (benches from stairs or slabs)

windowDetails.description: Make windows more interesting than plain glass
techniques: Use glass_pane instead of glass for depth
Add trapdoors on sides as shutters
Place flower_pot with flowers below window

doorDetails.description: Entrances set the tone for a build
techniques: Frame door with pillars (logs or stone)
Use path blocks leading to entrance
Add dormer windows on steep roofs
Include chimney with campfire inside for smoke
Mix in cracked/mossy variants for age

interiorFurniture.chair: oak_stairs with item_frame or sign as armrests
interiorFurniture.couch: 2-3 stairs in row with signs as arms
interiorFurniture.cabinet: barrel or chest with trapdoors as doors
interiorFurniture.bed_canopy: fence posts at corners + carpet/wool on top

gardenElements.hedge: row of leaf_blocks shaped with slabs on top
gardenElements.path: mix gravel + cobblestone + stone_button for texture
gardenElements.pond: dig 2 deep, add water, lilypads, sugar_cane
gardenElements.bench: 2 stairs facing each other or slabs + signs
gardenElements.lamp_post: fence posts stacked + lantern on top

textureVariation.floor_pattern: Alternate materials in checkerboard or stripe patterns
